episodes.label: Private Alarm
episodes.summary: Each robot sees its own alarm. Both must stop when either alarm turns red.

episodes.label: Crossed Waypoints
episodes.summary: Each robot can see only its teammate’s next targets. They must exchange them before they expire.

episodes.label: Blind Guidance
episodes.summary: A sighted aerial robot guides a ground robot that cannot see or localize itself.

episodes.label: Blind Guidance with hazards
episodes.summary: The same complementary team must also navigate around moving obstacles.
